name: orderdesk
description: An order desk for a small business: customer emails (dropped into inbox/, pasted, or handed over by the agent) become orders that reserve stock, large ones wait for approval, shipping writes a delivery note and tells the customer, arriving stock releases waiting orders. Messages land in outbox/ as .eml files, delivery notes in delivery-notes/. JSON routes the agent and the page call, and the desk as a widget on the first screen. Data in orderdesk.json in the app's home.
mount: a row `- id: orderdesk` / `name: orderdesk` before the server row in blend.yaml

config.store: an OrderDeskStore for tests (default: orderdesk.json in the app's home)
config.now: what time it is (ISO), for tests (default: the system clock)
config.sweepMs: how often the inbox/ folder is read (default 3000; 0 reads it once at start)
